description: Change a stream's settings (name, quality, framerate, duration, storage, backup ingest) and/or its YouTube broadcast settings via the `youtube` object. Where it publishes is add_stream_destination / set_stream_destination_enabled / remove_stream_destination; when it runs is schedule_stream. The `youtube` settings only apply when one of the stream's destinations is a YouTube channel connected through Streamloop — not a custom RTMP destination, and not YouTube reached through a raw RTMP URL and key — and are otherwise skipped with a notice. Set retryMirror=true to re-attempt mirroring the schedule onto YouTube after a reconnect or a quota recovery. PARTIAL SUCCESS: settings are applied first, so if the YouTube settings then fail, `stream` still reflects the applied settings and `youtubeSettingsError` explains the YouTube failure — the settings change is NOT rolled back.

framerate.description: Frames per second the stream is sent at.

quality.description: Output resolution sent to every destination; the account's preferred quality when omitted.

retryMirror.description: true re-attempts copying this stream's schedule onto its YouTube broadcast, e.g. after reconnecting the channel.

runBackupStream.description: Also publish to YouTube's backup ingest for redundancy. Doubles the streaming cost while live.

storageBackend.description: Media storage: standard (included) or large, for big playlists, billed per GiB-month.

streamDuration.description: Stop after this many seconds of streaming; 0 = run until stopped.

youtube.description: YouTube broadcast settings (title/privacy/thumbnail/etc.). ONLY take effect when the stream's destination is a YouTube channel connected through Streamloop. They are NOT supported for custom RTMP destinations or for streaming to YouTube via a raw RTMP URL and stream key — there is no API access to that broadcast. The tool skips them with a notice in that case.

adFrequency.description: How often Streamloop asks YouTube for a mid-roll ad break. Ads only serve on a channel in the YouTube Partner Program; off sends no breaks.

ageRestricted.description: Mark the broadcast 18+ on YouTube (yes), clear that mark (no), or leave YouTube's own setting alone (unspecified).

categoryID.description: YouTube's numeric video category id, as a string: "10" is Music, "20" Gaming, "22" People & Blogs.

defaultAudioLanguage.description: Language spoken in the broadcast audio, as a BCP-47 code such as en or es-MX.

defaultLanguage.description: Language of the title and description, as a BCP-47 code such as en or es-MX.

description.description: The text shown under the broadcast on YouTube.

embeddable.description: Allow other websites to embed the broadcast; false blocks embedding.

enableDvr.description: Let viewers pause and rewind the live broadcast on YouTube.

latencyPreference.description: YouTube's live latency mode: lower latency means faster chat interaction but less buffering against network hiccups.

madeForKids.description: YouTube's required made-for-kids (COPPA) declaration. A stream still at unspecified will not start until it is answered yes or no; ask the user, never assume.

privacy.description: Who can find and watch the broadcast on YouTube: everyone, only people with the link, or only the channel.

recordFromStart.description: Keep the broadcast on the channel as a video once it ends.

scheduleOnYoutubeWhenScheduled.description: When the stream is scheduled, create its YouTube broadcast right away so it shows as upcoming on the channel, instead of when the stream starts. Cannot change while the stream is live.

tags.description: YouTube search tags for the broadcast; replaces the current tags.

thumbnailObjectID.description: The image used when thumbnailSource is custom: a media id (obj_...) of an uploaded image, from list_uploads or create_upload.

thumbnailSource.description: Where the broadcast thumbnail comes from: auto takes a frame of the first video in the playlist, custom uses the image in thumbnailObjectID, none leaves YouTube's own thumbnail untouched.

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it
